name: PCI-DSS v4.0 Cardholder Data Security Compliance
description: Compliance framework for Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI-DSS) v4.0, covering Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) segmentation, primary account number (PAN) tokenization, key management, quarterly ASV vulnerability scanning, and annual ROC/SAQ attestation.

checklists.name: PCI-DSS v4.0 Security Controls & Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for PCI-DSS v4.0 Requirements 1-12 covering CDE isolation, encryption, access control, and logging.

items.statement: Sensitive Authentication Data (CVV2/CVC2, full track data, PINs) is never stored after transaction authorization.
Primary Account Numbers (PAN) are tokenized or encrypted using strong cryptography (AES-256) across all storage locations.
Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is enforced for all administrative and user access into the Cardholder Data Environment.
Quarterly Approved Scanning Vendor (ASV) vulnerability scans pass with zero high or critical CVSS vulnerabilities.
FIM (File Integrity Monitoring) alerts trigger automatically upon unauthorized changes to critical CDE system files.

reviewGates.name: PCI-DSS QSA Attestation Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Qualified Security Assessor (QSA) or PCI Internal Security Assessor (ISA) attests that CDE controls, tokenization, and ASV scans comply with PCI-DSS v4.0.
reviewGates.prompt: Has the Qualified Security Assessor verified CDE isolation, tokenization, and PCI-DSS v4.0 compliance?
